newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Powerful blast rocks centre of Chechen capital.
newsitem.headline: Powerful blast rocks centre of Chechen capital.

text.p: A powerful explosion rocked the centre of Grozny, capital of Russia's breakaway Chechnya region, on Wednesday, Russian news agencies said.

Itar-Tass news agency said there had been casualties but did not give any figures or details. Tens of thousands of people were killed in a 21-month war between local separatists and Russian troops. The fighting ended last August.
